composition: All eight plates share one 16:9 winter woodland composition with an open center for Naeru.

clear_day.prompt: Repaint the reference as unmistakable midwinter: bare deciduous branches, snow-covered evergreens, a deep fresh snowfield and distant winter mountains under a crisp icy noon sky. Preserve the open central meadow, camera and soft storybook background-painting style. Remove summer foliage, flowers and lush grass. No character or text.

clear_time_edits.dawn.png: Preserve the exact day geometry and change only winter dawn light: cold lavender-blue sky, restrained peach horizon, blue snow shadows and faint warm rim light.
clear_time_edits.dusk.png: Preserve the exact day geometry and change only winter dusk light: apricot and rose near the horizon, lavender upper sky, long cool snow shadows and subtle warm tree edges.
clear_time_edits.night.png: Preserve the exact day geometry and change only winter night light: deep navy sky with restrained stars, moonlit blue snow and legible dark tree silhouettes.

snow_weather.day-rain.png: Preserve the exact winter geometry and repaint a static overcast snow-weather day with layered blue-gray snow clouds and flat cold light. Do not paint falling flakes; the DOM precipitation layer supplies them.
snow_weather.dawn-rain.png: Preserve the exact geometry of day-rain and shift it to predawn blue-lavender light with only a faint muted warm horizon.
snow_weather.dusk-rain.png: Preserve the exact geometry of day-rain and shift it to dim stormy dusk with muted violet-gray clouds and a weak rose-brown horizon.
snow_weather.night-rain.png: Preserve the exact geometry of day-rain and shift it to a dark navy snow-cloud night with soft blue snow visibility and no stars.

foreground.prompt: Create a transparent winter foreground overlay only in the lower left and lower right corners: dormant twigs, sparse evergreen needles, dried seed heads, frost and small snow caps. Keep the center open and all upper areas transparent; no ground plane, snow bank, background, character, haze or detached alpha speckles. Lower the final clusters so the tallest left tips begin near 55% height and the right near 67%.

landscape.prompt: Extract the complete winter landscape as transparent RGBA while removing only the sky and clouds. Preserve exact snowfield, mountains, trees, trunks, overhanging branches and antialiased boundaries.
